verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ περιβεβλημένον νεφέλην καὶ ἡ ἶρις ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὡς στῦλοι πυρός
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon allon angelon ischyron katabainonta ek tou ouranou peribeblēmenon nephelēn kai hē iris epi tēn kephalēn autou kai to prosōpon autou hōs ho hēlios kai hoi podes autou hōs styloi pyros
verses.literal: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven wrapped in a cloud with a rainbow above his head His face was like the sun and his legs were like pillars of fire
verses.literalPt: Vi outro anjo forte descendo do céu, vestido de uma nuvem; o arco-íris estava sobre a sua cabeça; e o seu rosto era como o sol, e os seus pés, como colunas de fogo;

verses.original: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ βιβλαρίδιον ἠνεῳγμένον καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸν πόδα αὐτοῦ τὸν δεξιὸν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τὸν δὲ εὐώνυμον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: kai echōn en tē cheiri autou biblaridion ēneōgmenon kai ethēken ton poda autou ton dexion epi tēs thalassēs ton de euōnymon epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: He held in his hand a small scroll which lay open He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land
verses.literalPt: e tinha na mão um livrinho aberto. Pôs o pé direito sobre o mar; e o esquerdo; sobre a terra,

verses.original: καὶ ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ὥσπερ λέων μυκᾶται καὶ ὅτε ἔκραξεν ἐλάλησαν αἱ ἑπτὰ βρονταὶ τὰς ἑαυτῶν φωνάς
verses.transliteration: kai ekraxen phōnē megalē hōsper leōn mykatai kai hote ekraxen elalēsan hai hepta brontai tas heautōn phōnas
verses.literal: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion And when he cried out the seven thunders sounded their voices
verses.literalPt: e bradou com uma grande voz, como o rugido de leão. Quando bradou, os sete trovões fizeram soar as suas vozes.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐλάλησαν αἱ ἑπτὰ βρονταί ἤμελλον γράφειν καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λέγουσαν Σφράγισον ἃ ἐλάλησαν αἱ ἑπτὰ βρονταί καὶ μὴ αὐτὰ γράψῃς
verses.transliteration: Kai hote elalēsan hai hepta brontai ēmellon graphein kai ēkousa phōnēn ek tou ouranou legousan Sphragison ha elalēsan hai hepta brontai kai mē auta grapsēs
verses.literal: When the seven thunders had spoken I was about to put it in writing But I heard a voice from heaven saying Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down
verses.literalPt: Quando os sete trovões fizeram soar as suas vozes, eu ia escrever; mas ouvi uma voz do céu, dizendo: Sela as coisas que falaram os sete trovões e não as escrevas.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος ὃν εἶδον ἑστῶτα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἦρεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τὴν δεξιὰν εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho angelos hon eidon hestōta epi tēs thalassēs kai epi tēs gēs ēren tēn cheira autou tēn dexian eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven
verses.literalPt: O anjo que vi em pé sobre o mar e sobre a terra levantou a destra para o céu

verses.original: καὶ ὤμοσεν ἐν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ὃς ἔκτισεν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ὅτι Χρόνος οὐκέτι ἔσται
verses.transliteration: kai ōmosen en tō zōnti eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn hos ektisen ton ouranon kai ta en autō kai tēn gēn kai ta en autē kai tēn thalassan kai ta en autē hoti Chronos ouketi estai
verses.literal: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever who created heaven and everything in it the earth and everything in it and the sea and everything in it There will be no more delay
verses.literalPt: e jurou por aquele que vive pelos séculos dos séculos, que criou o céu, e tudo o que nele há, e a terra, e tudo o que nela há, e o mar, e tudo o que nele há, que não haveria mais demora;

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ ἑβδόμου ἀγγέλου ὅταν μέλλῃ σαλπίζειν καὶ ἐτελέσθη τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς εὐηγγέλισεν τοὺς ἑαυτοῦ δούλους τοὺς προφήτας
verses.transliteration: all’ en tais hēmerais tēs phōnēs tou hebdomou angelou hotan mellē salpizein kai etelesthē to mystērion tou Theou hōs euēngelisen tous heautou doulous tous prophētas
verses.literal: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel when he begins to sound his trumpet the mystery of God will be fulfilled just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets
verses.literalPt: mas que, nos dias da voz do sétimo anjo, quando este estiver para tocar a trombeta, então, se cumprirá o mistério de Deus, segundo ele anunciou aos seus servos, os profetas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἣν ἤκουσα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πάλιν λαλοῦσαν μετ’ ἐμοῦ καὶ λέγουσαν Ὕπαγε λάβε τὸ βιβλίον τὸ ἠνεῳγμένον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ ἑστῶτος ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai hē phōnē hēn ēkousa ek tou ouranou palin lalousan met’ emou kai legousan Hypage labe to biblion to ēneōgmenon en tē cheiri tou angelou tou hestōtos epi tēs thalassēs kai epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again saying Go take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land
verses.literalPt: A voz que eu ouvi do céu, tornei a ouvi-la falando comigo e dizendo: Vai e toma o livro que está aberto na mão do anjo que está em pé sobre o mar e sobre a terra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθα πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον λέγων αὐτῷ Δοῦναί μοι τὸ βιβλαρίδιον Καὶ λέγει μοι Λάβε καὶ κατάφαγε αὐτό καὶ πικρανεῖ σου τὴν κοιλίαν ἀλλ’ ἐν τῷ στόματί σου ἔσται γλυκὺ ὡς μέλι
verses.transliteration: Kai apēltha pros ton angelon legōn autō Dounai moi to biblaridion Kai legei moi Labe kai kataphage auto kai pikranei sou tēn koilian all’ en tō stomati sou estai glyky hōs meli
verses.literal: And I went to the angel and said Give me the small scroll Take it and eat it he said - It will make your stomach bitter but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey
verses.literalPt: Fui ter com o anjo, pedindo-lhe que me desse o livrinho. Toma-o, disse-me ele, e come-o; causar-te-á amargor no ventre, mas na tua boca será doce como mel.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ βιβλαρίδιον ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ ἀγγέλου καὶ κατέφαγον αὐτό καὶ ἦν ἐν τῷ στόματί μου ὡς μέλι γλυκύ καὶ ὅτε ἔφαγον αὐτό ἐπικράνθη ἡ κοιλία μου
verses.transliteration: Kai elabon to biblaridion ek tēs cheiros tou angelou kai katephagon auto kai ēn en tō stomati mou hōs meli glyky kai hote ephagon auto epikranthē hē koilia mou
verses.literal: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth But when I had eaten it my stomach turned bitter
verses.literalPt: Tomei o livrinho da mão do anjo e o comi; na minha boca, era doce como mel, mas, depois de o comer, causou-me amargor no ventre.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγουσίν μοι Δεῖ σε πάλιν προφητεῦσαι ἐπὶ λαοῖς καὶ ἔθνεσιν καὶ γλώσσαις καὶ βασιλεῦσιν πολλοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai legousin moi Dei se palin prophēteusai epi laois kai ethnesin kai glōssais kai basileusin pollois
verses.literal: And they told me You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings
verses.literalPt: Disseram-me: Cumpre que ainda profetizes a respeito de muitos povos, raças, línguas e reis.
